usage: tr daily [-h] [--session SESSION] [--top TOP] [--max-usd MAX_USD]
                [--dry-run] [--no-model] [--teachers]
                [--teacher-max-usd TEACHER_MAX_USD]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --session SESSION     a completed session (default: the latest, after 16:15
                        ET)
  --top TOP             analyze the screen's top N (default 10, SPIKE §4.2)
  --max-usd MAX_USD     stop before the next model call that would take the
                        run past this (default 1.00)
  --dry-run             free steps only (reconcile writes nothing): print what
                        would be analyzed and its cost
  --no-model            run the free steps for real; skip analyze and thesis
  --teachers            then run the 3 pinned teachers on the session's 4
                        drawn bake-off names (paid, SPIKE §9.4); a teacher
                        failure never changes the exit code
  --teacher-max-usd TEACHER_MAX_USD
                        stop the teacher step before a call whose worst case
                        would take this session's teacher spend past this
                        (default 0.40)
